title: A 4x Inc 5000 founder who met Eric at the conference, a fortnight on — 'these are the thoughts that I’ve been swimming with over the past week'
summary: Anderson runs Luma Brighter Learning and has made the Inc 5000 four times. His post is not about the book so much as caused by it: a reflection on what the resource-gathering is finally for, ending on the culture his team built and protects. The book is named as what set the week's thinking going, with the meeting at the Inc 5000 Conference as the occasion.
blockquote: I’ve been reading the book Incorruptible, by Eric Ries, who I’ve had the pleasure of meeting at the Inc 5000 Conference last week. (Excellent book, by the way!). And these are the thoughts that I’ve been swimming with over the past week.
